title: 2026-11-18 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：NVFP4-MLA: Unified FP4 KV-Cache Storage and Attention Computation for Multi-Head Latent Attention (NVIDIA, FP4 不只是省显存：MLA 的 KV cache 压 3 倍后精度持平，注意力 kernel 比 FP8 版本快 2.7–2.8 倍。)、Making Preemption Productive in Long-Output LLM Serving (National University of Singapore, 把抢占当成可复用状态而非重算：p99 每 token 时间降 50.7%，整个 replay 提前 10.7% 完成。)、Supercharging Olmo-core for Efficient and Scalable MoE Training (Allen Institute for AI, 把 EP 做成真正无同步的 rowwise 写入，1.2T 模型在 512 卡上跑出 858 useful TFLOP/s/GPU。)

highlights.name: NVFP4-MLA
highlights.note: MLA 的 KV 存储与注意力计算一起压到 FP4，精度持平且比 FP8 kernel 快 2.8x

highlights.name: Making Preemption Productive
highlights.note: 长输出服务的抢占不再是丢弃重算，p99 每 token 时间降 50.7%

highlights.name: Supercharging Olmo-core (MoE)
highlights.note: NVSHMEM rowwise EP 消除 dispatch 置换，1.2T 模型达 858 TFLOP/s/GPU
